prompt: Which North Atlantic tropical storm, whose peak intensity remained at tropical storm level, caused the highest number of deaths last year?
answer: **Tropical Storm Chantal** caused the most deaths among 2025 North Atlantic systems that never exceeded tropical-storm strength. It caused **six direct deaths**, mostly from flooding in North Carolina.
